Boil 500ml water, add 500g chopped carrots (fingers) and cabbage (strips), cook until tender.
Boil 300ml water with 100g carrots and 100g onion until soft. Blend, adding cornflour gradually to thicken. Season with pepper, sage, and rosemary, then blitz again until smooth.

Roll out the pastry on a clean board and spread half the cooled mixture evenly, leaving a 1-inch border.
Sprinkle with half of the Cheddar cheese, roll up tightly, and cut into 10 slices.

Use a stick blender or food processor to blend to a smooth paste.
If a little thick, use the water kept from the tins to make a spreading consistency.

Stir in dairy-free spread until melted.
Add flour, stir, then gradually whisk in milk to make a smooth thick sauce.

Serve pies with roasted potatoes & cooked broccoli.

Stir in chopped tomatoes, stock, and basil. Simmer gently for 10 minutes.
When cod is cooked, flake into large chunks and add to the sauce.
Prepare couscous according to packet instructions.
Steam or boil green beans until tender.
Serve cod and vegetable sauce with couscous and green beans.

Stir in chopped tomatoes, butterbeans, basil, and smoked paprika. Simmer for 10 minutes.

Serve the stew hot with warm baguette slices.

Serve immediately.
